ModMetaData.name: Raiders Have Families
ModMetaData.author: Pavuchicha
ModMetaData.description: Experimental v0.2.0 for RimWorld 1.7. Event-driven Harmony family links for raiders, visitors and traders; optional prisoner ransom via comms, rank-aware offers and boosted vanilla reprisals. Optional WCE2 surgery event integration; performance budgets. Not all planned rescue-mission AI is implemented. Back up saves.
